shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- routing entries ---\\n' && rg -n -i -C 3 'toast|button.*toast|notify' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- setup docs ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && printf '\\n--- toast docs ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*toast*' -type f | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- main ---' && cat src/main.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- routing top ---'; sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- uikit required setup docs ---'; rg -n -i -C 5 'required setup|mobile|modal|toast' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- toast doc files ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -iname '*toast*' -type f | head -40; printf '%s\\n' '--- uikit package source ---'; rg -n \"useToaster|Toaster\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm src 2>/dev/null | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- toast types ---'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- Toaster component ---'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null || find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster -maxdepth 3 -type f -name '*.d.ts' -print; printf '%s\\n' '--- hook/types ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -maxdepth 3 -name 'index*' | head -20 && rg -n \"ToasterComponent|ToasterProvider|class Toaster|useToaster\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build --glob '*.d.ts' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "patch -p0 <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/App.tsx
@@
-import { useState } from 'react';
+import { useState } from 'react';
*** End Patch
PATCH"
